summary: Server state of one drop/throw request on the character that drops entities (born in the 'shove-throw' step together with the other esv::drop types). Built by esv::drop::DropEntityRequestSystem::AddDropEntityComponent from an EntityDropRequest (LEGACY_RequestDropEntities(entity, entities, Vector3f, Optional<Quaternionf>)).

fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: esv::drop::DropEntityDescription (name from ls::IndexedStorage<struct esv::drop::DropEntityDescription> assert in AddDropEntityComponent, EoCServer.dll+0x9AE3B0): +0 = the dropped entity of the request's entity list (stride 0x10); AddDropEntityComponent later adds a component with the dropper handle to each of them.

fields.name: Amount
fields.evidence: Second qword of the request element = ls::Optional<int> amount (LEGACY_RequestDropEntity(..., Optional<int> const&); LEGACY_RequestDropEntities stores 0 in the flag byte +0xC). AddDropEntityComponent clears the flag byte (local_170._0_5_) when no split is needed.

fields.name: HasAmount
fields.evidence: Flag byte of the Optional<int> (LEGACY_RequestDropEntities writes 0 at element+0xC).

fields.name: Entities
fields.evidence: AddDropEntityComponent (EoCServer.dll+0x9AE3B0) appends 16-byte DropEntityDescription elements to the new component's array at +0 (capacity +8, size +0xC). Live (2 instances): heap pointer, capacity 1, size 1. Windows save loader converter bg3.exe+0x27769C0 appends 16-byte elements: EntityHandle from the saved EntityId at +0, int32 at +8 and its flag byte at +0xC only when the saved optional is set.

fields.name: Position
fields.evidence: AddDropEntityComponent: plVar17[2] = request+8 (8 bytes) and +0x18 = request+0x10; LEGACY_RequestDropEntities fills request+8..+0x14 from its Vector3f const& argument. Live floats 56.25/17.24/104.8 and 127.2/54.65/-420.2 (world positions). Windows loader converter bg3.exe+0x27769C0 stores the level-transformed vec3 (bg3.exe+0x2772030) as 8 bytes at +0x10 and 4 at +0x18.

fields.name: Rotation
fields.evidence: Value storage of an ls::Optional<Quaternionf>. Windows save loader bg3.exe+0x25E3880 (model ls::model::game::drop::v1::DropEntityStateComponent, 64 bytes) via converter bg3.exe+0x27769C0: when the model's flag is set, rotates the model quaternion by the level transform (bg3.exe+0x27744C0) and stores 16 bytes at +0x1C, then sets +0x2C = 1; the default constructor does NOT initialise +0x1C..+0x2B, so the four floats are garbage while HasRotation is 0 (that is why the raw check found 'not an ordinary float'). Declared as std::array<float, 4> rather than glm::quat for that reason. AddDropEntityComponent copies request+0x14..+0x24 here.

fields.name: HasRotation
fields.evidence: Flag of the Optional<Quaternionf> (request+0x24 -> +0x2C). Live 0 in both instances (throw had no rotation).

fields.name: RequestGuid
fields.evidence: AddDropEntityComponent stores the ls::Guid::Generate() result at plVar17[6..7]; DropEntityExecuteSystem::ProcessWaitingForActionResourceSpending (EoCServer.dll+0x9B4590) compares state+0x30 with the Guid of eoc::ActionResourceSpendEventOneFrameComponent elements and copies it into DropEntityExecutionComponent+0. Live: equals DropEntityExecution+0 and ActionResourceSpendRequestOneFrame+0. Windows loader converter bg3.exe+0x27769C0 defaults +0x30..+0x3F from the null Guid DAT_14625aad0 and the loader copies 16 bytes there.

open_questions: Meaning of the Optional<int32> per entity (stack amount to drop is assumed); the savegame model has no member names.
second_pass: Offsets and widths confirmed by the Windows save loader bg3.exe+0x25E3880 and its converter bg3.exe+0x27769C0 (16-byte entries {EntityHandle, Optional<int32>}, vec3 at +0x10, optional quaternion +0x1C with flag +0x2C, Guid +0x30). Rotation is now std::array<float, 4>: it is the storage of an optional that the constructor leaves uninitialised, which made the raw check fail on glm::quat.
raw_check: 14 instances, se-fork/coverage/check.py raw stage, game v4.76.31.656
